fixed.explanation: BlockManager.fast_xs returns a view of the single block's values for a row. After a non-contiguous column take, that block is a temporary (columns x rows) array, so the small Series keeps the whole thing alive. I changed fast_xs to copy a numpy row that is a view into a much larger array, so the result no longer pins the temporary. Arrays that are not larger than a small multiple of the result are still returned as views.

query.intent: DataFrame row selection with a scalar row key and a list of non-contiguous columns goes through a take/xs/_getitem_nocopy path that builds a temporary 2D (columns x rows) block array, then slices a single row from it as a view. The resulting Series should copy its data (or otherwise not reference the temporary base) when the row is extracted from a consolidated temporary block.
query.symptom: Selecting one row and a non-adjacent list of columns returns a small Series whose values are a view into a large temporary array, retaining memory proportional to the number of rows.
